notes: Summary: SaaS knowledge-base for two product lines (Help & Docs + Internal KB). Goal: replace aging Elasticsearch pipeline with embeddings + lightweight reranker to reduce false positives and speed up time-to-resolution.
Scale: ~8M active passages today, planning to grow to ~12M. Typical doc length short (100-400 tokens), but many near-duplicates and frequent updates (hourly sync).
Traffic profile: read-heavy search volume. Peak QPS target for hosted API is 250-500 sustained, spiky to ~800 during product launches.

Latency target: P95 end-to-end under 150ms for recall+rerank; P99 requirement negotiable but customer wants indicative numbers. Cost target: < $0.002/query average (including initial embed recall + top-k rerank).
Architecture ask: use hosted API for embeddings + hosted reranker (preference) OR route rerank to Dedicated if cost-effective. Want built-in prefix/KV caching and per-route caching TTLs.
Security notes: SSO/SAML for console, SOC2 required, audit logs and retention controls critical. Data residency: US-only for now (may add EU later).
Quotes from AE call: 'We need predictable economics — if reranking doubles our cost per query it's a non-starter.'
POC criteria: ingest realistic snapshot (8M docs), run 24hr sustained QPS test at 300 QPS, gather per-token and per-query cost, measure 95/99 latencies, verify cache hit improvements.
Ops constraints: hourly indexing window; want incremental index API and low-latency prefix/KV cache invalidation. Concern about long-tail cold-start latency for recently updated docs.
Competitive notes: already trialed Pinecone + local reranker (too costly at scale), considered vector DB + custom microservice reranker but want managed inference to avoid ops burden.
Internal stakeholders: VP Product (decision maker), Head of Search Eng (technical lead), Infrastructure Manager (procurement/security gate).
Procurement timeline: legal & security review started 2026-02; expect procurement by 2026-04 if POC meets cost/latency goals.
Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize for batching and quantization suggestions, Dedicated reserved capacity if run rate justifies it.

use_case_and_requirements: Embeddings-first retrieval with a lightweight transformer reranker for top-10 candidates. Primary KPIs: avg cost/query, 95th/99th percentile latency, recall@10. Index size: 8-12M passages; doc churn: hourly; peak QPS 500-800. Prefers hosted API to minimize ops; open to Dedicated if unit economics favor it.
po_notes: Pricing sensitivity noted. Wants examples of customers with similar scale. Asked for explicit calculation template mapping tokens -> cost -> monthly ARR estimate.
sales_play_notes: Position Redwood Optimize for reducing per-query cost via batching and quantization; highlight KV/prefix caching to lower cold-start cost; propose canary rollout path from hosted to Dedicated if growth requires. Emphasize transparent per-route dashboards.
